item.title: Warm room overlooking a silent snow lake | Relaxing Sleep Story | 1 Hour
item.description:
If today was long, let this quiet story ease you.

The window felt cold, a clear barrier to the winter night. Inside, the air was warm, carrying the scent of old firewood, as snow softly covered the lake outside.

Step into a warm refuge from the winter night. Feel the gentle contrast of a cozy room and the silent, snow-covered world outside. A tranquil space awaits, where the soft glow of distant light touches frosted surfaces and the only sound is the quiet stillness of morning.

item.title: 58 YEARS LATER: 4 HUMANS RETURN to the Moon | Artemis II
item.description:
Join us as we journey to unravel deep space's ultimate mystery.

The charred Orion capsule returned, but why did it take 58 years to retrace Apollo 8's path? Something made deep space far more perilous for Artemis.

The return of Artemis II after 58 years reignites a crucial question: why did it take so long to retrace Apollo 8's lunar path? We delve into the unexpected dangers deep space now holds, revealed by the Orion capsule's journey. Discover the scientific reasons why human spaceflight beyond Earth's protective magnetosphere has become significantly more perilous for a new generation of explorers.

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 Orion heat shield sinks
06:31 April tenth, twenty twenty-six
17:59 Behind headlines and relief
26:14 If orbital physics unchanged
28:59 Houston mission control
39:18 Here begins the strange part
